description: This file contains utility functions for hand landmark detection using MediaPipe inside an API service, including functions to process images, create masks based on landmarks, and run inference asynchronously.

classes.name: Landmark
classes.description: Data schema representing a 3D landmark point (x, y, z)

methods.name: np.ndarray _compute_hull_mask(points_xy: np.ndarray, width: int, height: int)
methods.description: Creates a binary mask of the convex hull from landmark points

methods.name: Tuple[List[Landmark],Optional[str],float] _run_mediapipe_inference(rgb_image: np.ndarray)
methods.description: Runs MediaPipe Hands inference on an RGB image and returns landmarks, mask data URI, and confidence

methods.name: Tuple[List[Landmark],Optional[str],float] detect_hand_via_mediapipe(pil_image)
methods.description: Asynchronously runs MediaPipe Hands detection in a separate thread and returns landmarks, mask, and confidence
